Overview

The LILYGO T-Echo is a highly integrated portable device combining Nordic Semiconductor nRF52840 multiprotocol SoC with a Semtech SX1262 LoRa radio, a Quectel L76K multi-GNSS receiver, and a 1.54-inch e-paper display in a compact handheld form factor. With an 850mAh battery, the T-Echo can operate for days between charges, making it ideal for off-grid mesh networking, outdoor navigation, and long-range sensor monitoring.

The nRF52840 provides Bluetooth 5.0, Thread 1.3, Zigbee 3.0, ANT, and 802.15.4 protocols simultaneously, making the T-Echo one of the most versatile wireless platforms available. The SX1262 LoRa radio covers 433, 868, and 915 MHz bands with +22 dBm output power and -148 dBm sensitivity for multi-kilometer range. The L76K GNSS module supports GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, and QZSS constellations.

The T-Echo is the official reference hardware for Meshtastic LoRa mesh networking and also runs SoftRF aircraft tracking firmware. An optional BME280 variant adds barometric pressure, temperature, and humidity sensing. The 1.54-inch e-paper display with 200×200 resolution provides persistent information display without battery drain.
